name: listicle
description: 逐条清单：编号列表逐行入场风格
css: #tpl-listicle { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 0 9%; background: #10101c; } #tpl-listicle .li-heading { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; margin-bottom: 44px; } #tpl-listicle .li-item { font-size: 34px; color: #c8d4ff; margin: 20px 0; padding-left: 20px; border-left: 4px solid #6d8bff; }
